list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. All single-player, no online trophies.
sources_note: Every guide below cites the official trophy description as published by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles) and, where a method comes from a launch guide, that guide by name and link. Where a method is inferred from the official description rather than a published guide, the guide says so plainly. Difficulty and time are this guide's own estimates.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.when: After the other 54 trophies
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then strangers, then activities, then collectibles and the 100% checklist) and it pops last. The longest stretch is A Long Road, the 100% completion Gold, which launch guides put at around 100 hours of mop-up after the story.
steps: Finish the story and the five stranger chains.
Clear the activities, combat feats and collectibles in phases 3–4.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits and work the 35 requirements for A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.when: After the story — checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. The list only becomes visible after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) but everything you did before already counts, and launch guides agree nothing on it is missable. It has 35 requirements and is forgiving: most ask for only part of a total — about 60% of true completion, per PowerPyx. Required in full are the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), underwater discoveries, Shooting Range golds (42 of 42), drone time trials (42 of 42) and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Everything else is partial: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 30 of 40 unique races, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 30 of 34 magazines, 5 of 7 Kenton sets and 100 of 125 flamingos.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the 35 requirements.
Clear the full-requirement items first: all robberies, underwater discoveries, 42 Shooting Range golds, 42 drone trials, 15 Target Decks.
Mop up the partial counts — stunts, challenges, races, card sets, vehicles, meditations — a few at a time as you travel.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.when: Any time — counts build up across the whole game
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in the game, and the 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep doing them as you travel rather than leaving all 250 for the end — every jump, near-miss and airtime moment counts toward the total. Stunts are tracked in the in-game Progress database, so you can check your count there.
steps: Do stunts whenever you travel — jumps, airtime, near misses.
Check your count under Progress to see how close to 250 you are.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.when: Any time — sample the open world
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The launch guides count 9 types — the game's activities include fishing, drone racing, the Shooting Range, arcade games, bowling, races, meditation, hunting and minigames. You only need to try each one, not finish or win it, so a quick sample of each is enough. Inferred from the official description and the launch guides' count of 9 types; the exact list of types is the game's own activity menu.
steps: Open the map's Activities filter to see what is available near you.
Try one of each: fish, race a drone, shoot a range challenge, play an arcade game, bowl, race, meditate, hunt, and one more minigame.
The trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.when: Any time — two ranges: Griffin and Rodgers Ranch
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two ranges — Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch — and the 100% checklist also requires all 42 golds, so this trophy and that checklist line are the same work. Launch guides note you can buy a $5 waiver pass from the clerk first; inferred from those guides, the waiver smooths the range challenges. Take it slow and steady: gold is about accuracy, not speed.
steps: Visit Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch.
Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk, per the launch guides.
Work through all 42 challenges until each shows gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.when: Any time — 14 Top Fun locations
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy. Each location has 3 time trials (42 in all); you must beat the par time on the first two to unlock the third, which you only need to finish. The 100% checklist wants all 42 trials, so finish each location while you are there. Locations appear as blue map icons when you are within about 100 metres, or use Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones to find them.
steps: Find a Top Fun location on the map (blue icon within ~100 m, or the Activities filter).
Beat the par time on the first two trials, then finish the third.
Repeat at all 14 locations — one win each is the trophy; all 42 trials is the 100% line.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.when: Any time — 40 unique races exist
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique races to choose from, and winning the same race again does not count — each win must be a race you have not won before. The 100% checklist asks for 30 of the 40, so keep racing past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. Race challenges count separately: the checklist also wants 10 golds from 13 race challenges.
steps: Pick races you have not won yet — the map shows which venues you have cleared.
Win 20 different ones; repeats do not count.
Keep going to 30 wins for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 — do the first meditation before leaving the chapter
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in all, of which the 100% checklist asks for 15. This is the one trophy launch guides flag as possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, reported gone after that chapter, and it is unconfirmed whether that spot counts toward the trophy — so meditate there before you finish Chapter 1 to be safe. GTABase and PowerPyx both flag it, and KeenGamer's roadmap makes the Chapter 1 meditation step 3 of its platinum route. The other spots stay available in free roam.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house (Lucia on the balcony) before finishing the chapter.
Find and meditate at the remaining 17 quiet spots across Leonida.
The trophy pops on the 18th spot; 15 of 18 also count toward 100%.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house is reported gone after that chapter, and it is unconfirmed whether it counts toward the 18 — meditate there before finishing Chapter 1 or the platinum may be locked out. GTABase and PowerPyx both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.when: Any time — cards are everywhere in Leonida
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets holding 480 cards in all, with sets of 12, 18, 24, 30 or 36 cards — pick the three smallest sets to finish fastest. Cards turn up in yellow phone boxes, tool boxes and on surfaces inside buildings. The 100% checklist asks for 15 complete sets (at least 372 cards depending on which sets you pick), so keep collecting past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. Completing the 24-card Vice City Flamingos set also unlocks the Bubblegum cheat, per PowerPyx.
steps: Pick up cards as you travel — phone boxes, tool boxes, building surfaces.
Finish any 3 complete sets; the smallest sets are fastest.
Keep going to 15 sets for the 100% checklist.
